title: Intraoperative event documentation prompt

user_facing_items.final_wording: Supports re-evaluation, equipment, medicines, staff, monitoring, techniques, positioning, lines and procedures, unusual events, fluids or blood products, output, and transfer status as recorded facts.
user_facing_items.population: Patients receiving anesthesia services across preanesthesia, intraoperative, and postanesthesia phases.
user_facing_items.setting: Anesthesia care continuum and anesthesia medical records.
restrictions: Exact for documentation fields and continuity of anesthesia records. It supports recording clinician-assessed facts and completed plans, not generating management, medicines, doses, procedures, referrals, discharge, or urgency.
user_facing_items.rationale: The exact ASA statement supports recording unusual or noteworthy intraoperative events, monitoring, interventions, fluids, products, output, and transfer status as facts.
